name: Hear
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the vital importance of hearing as a means of receiving God's message and responding in faith. Ezekiel 3:27 highlights the call to hear God's word despite rebellion, while Matthew 11:15 urges those with spiritual receptivity to listen attentively. Romans 10:17 connects hearing directly to the growth of faith, affirming that faith arises from hearing the word of God, underscoring hearing as essential to the believer's relationship with Christ.
